title: No emission and no enforcement for external names: buildAgentPolicies() emits only vteam-governed names; worker guard pass-through for unmapped agents is preserved
claim: An external engine agent (Prometheus/Sisyphus/build/plan/oracle/general/explore/librarian/multimodal-looker/...) is genuinely outside vteam enforcement: no policy artifact is emitted for it on the server, and the worker guard does not govern it (unmapped -> allow, the deliberate pass-through safety property).
externalNamesSource: todo 1 live evidence .omo/evidence/third-party-agent-display/task-1-api.json (24 live engine agents minus the 8 governed names), incl. space/uppercase/hyphen variants to prove no fuzzy/prefix match leaks them

serverAssertions.suite: agent-policies 零发射：外部/引擎 agent 名绝不进入策略集（third-party-agent-display Todo 4）
tests: agents[].name 与 guard.roles 键集恰为 7 个受治理内置名（硬编码期望 + 常量交叉校验）
不变式：每个发射名都是 vteam- 前缀 + AGENT_KEY_PATTERN 键；违例为空且样本非空
真实引擎外部名（含大小写/空格变体）在 agents 与 guard.roles 两侧均零出现（无模糊/前缀泄漏）
发射并集恰为 内置 ∪ vteam-<agentKey>（多一个名即失败；两侧同集）
外部引擎名（含大小写/空格变体）在自定义块存在时仍零出现
自定义发出名可从 mock 行独立推导：vteam-demo-agent / vteam-zeta 均在两侧
serverAssertions.oracleIndependence: expected governed sets are hardcoded (7 explicit builtins, cross-checked against ROLE_BOUNDARIES keys) or derived from this spec's own mocked DB rows; no expected value is read back from buildAgentPolicies()
serverAssertions.invariant: every emitted name is `vteam-` + a string matching AGENT_KEY_PATTERN (^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$); violations must be empty and sample size > 0
serverAssertions.governedSetEquality: union(agents[].name, guard.roles keys) === expected governed set for the mocked DB rows (7 builtins with empty custom rows; 7 builtins + vteam-demo-agent + vteam-zeta with custom rows)

workerAssertions.passThroughProperty: policy.ts:117-121 (branch 2): session unmapped or session.agent not a key in roles -> { action: 'allow' }. This is deliberate, never fail-closed.

worker/src/role-guard/policy.spec.ts: 真实引擎外部名（含大写/空格/连字符）对全部危险调用一律 allow（非空转：断言数 > 0）
对照：受治理角色同一 rolesDoc 下危险调用被 deny（上面的 allow 绝非空转）
判定为精确键匹配：大小写/空白/后缀/裸前缀变体均未映射 → 仍 pass-through
治理边界 = guard 键集：外部名与带 vteam- 前缀的未映射名同类 pass-through
roles 键集不含外部名（服务端零发射的下游面）：外部名无匹配条目，只可能 pass-through
worker/src/exec/exec-server.spec.ts: 非 vteam agent / 未传 agent：不写映射（未映射 pass-through，不建目录） — extended the agent list from [undefined, 'build'] to [undefined, 'build', 'prometheus', 'oracle', 'Prometheus - Plan Builder', 'Sisyphus-Junior']

workerAssertions.processGatePinned: exec-server.ts:1129 `if (!agent.startsWith('vteam-')) return;` — only vteam- names get a session→policy mapping; external names are never mapped, so the guard only sees them via branch 2 pass-through
